classification.difficultyReason: Apply the specified anticlockwise quarter-turn, tracking coordinate order and signs, then plot and read each image; no transformation must be inferred.

content.prompt: Plot the points listed below onto a number plane and rotate them $90^\circ$ anticlockwise about $(0,0)$. Write down the coordinates of each image point.

answer.worked: A quarter-turn anticlockwise about $(0,0)$ takes the point 2 units right and 1 unit down to 1 unit right and 2 units up. Thus $A'(1,2)$.
A quarter-turn anticlockwise about $(0,0)$ takes the point 2 units right and 2 units down to 2 units right and 2 units up. Thus $B'(2,2)$.
A quarter-turn anticlockwise about $(0,0)$ takes the point 3 units left and 4 units up to 4 units left and 3 units down. Thus $C'(-4,-3)$.
A quarter-turn anticlockwise about $(0,0)$ takes the point 4 units left and 4 units down to 4 units right and 4 units down. Thus $D'(4,-4)$.

spec.description: All original points and their quarter-turn anticlockwise images.
